title: 628. Delete Operation for Two Strings

examples.explanation: Remove s from the first and t from the second to get ea in both.
Nothing matches, so both characters must go.

hints: Only deletions are allowed, so the kept characters must appear in order in both strings.
The longest keepable part is the longest common subsequence of the two words.
Answer equals len(word1) + len(word2) - 2 * LCS length.
